bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
echo "CREATEVDO_RESTART_DIAG"
docker inspect --format 'STATE={{.State.Status}} EXIT={{.State.ExitCode}} RESTARTS={{.RestartCount}} OOM={{.State.OOMKilled}} ERROR={{.State.Error}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>/dev/null || echo NO_CONTAINER
echo "RECENT_FATAL_CODES"
docker logs --tail 110 gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>&1 | sed -E 's#[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{32,}#[REDACTED]#g; s#(https?://)[^[:space:]]+#\1[REDACTED]#g' | grep -Ei 'error|fail|denied|fatal|missing|not found|failed|permission|migration|startup|invalid|connect|ready|restart|poll|timeout' | tail -30 || true
echo "DIRTY_TRACKED"
git -C "$repo" status --short --untracked-files=no | head -35
echo "IMAGE_TAG"
docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
echo "CREATEVDO_RESTART_DIAG_END"
